blocks.text: The received book of Jeremiah contains several kinds of material, including poetry, prose sermons, narratives, letters, headings, restoration collections, and oracles concerning nations. A practical outline places the nation oracles in chapters 46–51. Ancient textual forms of Jeremiah also differ substantially: the Old Greek version is shorter and arranges the nation oracles earlier and differently. These features are matters of scholarly discussion, so they should not be used to settle the book’s composition by themselves.
